shared_harness.detail: org-brain is not registered in pr-team-harness; no external reviewer result is represented here.

checks.name: benchmark-label isolation
checks.evidence: Static and runtime tests reject benchmark names, question identifiers, gold answers, and scorer labels in retrieval calls.

checks.name: v3 coexistence
checks.evidence: Local and shared tests keep hybrid_v3 behavior while exercising hybrid_v4.

checks.name: ACL and suppression
checks.evidence: Local adapter and hybrid_v4 tests cover tenant, permission, validity, suppression, rebuild, and deletion behavior.

checks.name: claim integrity
checks.evidence: Only Mem0, Hindsight, and Mnemosyne are ranked; the other seven remain reference-only. OrgBrain now records 100% accuracy and pass^5 on the development 200, while the status artifact still blocks the scoped claim until repeat-5 competitor and weighted scorecard evidence is complete.

open_risks: The 1,000-record performance smoke is not evidence for the 10M acceptance gate.
The ONNX model winner is intentionally unset until the frozen lexicographic selection can run.
D1 and Vectorize changes have dry-run build coverage but no production smoke in this change.
Hindsight completed one 200-task readiness run; its repeat-5 final result is still missing.
OrgBrain average context is 1158.33 tokens, above the current competitive-memory-v1 target of 713.25 tokens.
Weighted personal and organization capability scorecards are still incomplete for all four adapters.
The allowed claim is scoped to the three ranked competitors and is not a universal OSS claim.
